# COLOR_MODES — S15aj (generated by contrast.py; edit MODES there, then rerun)

Six modes, ONE token layer. Reuse S15ah's mechanism as built (do not rebuild it): one `:root[data-theme="<id>"]` block per mode in
`Build/web/src/app/styles.css` + one entry per mode in `Build/web/src/shell/theme.mjs` PALETTES (`dark: true` for dark/midnight/graphite),
key `localStorage["r2s.theme"]`, inline THEME_SCRIPT before paint. System keeps S15ah behaviour (light/dark by prefers-color-scheme);
add: `prefers-contrast: more` + System -> contrast. Theme menu = Amplitude-style preview tiles (DESIGN_DIRECTION M13).

**Accent decision (S15aj, overrides S15ah's indigo #4f46e5 / #8b93ff):** indigo-on-white is the default look of every AI SaaS
template (myfront: "too common in this AI/vibe slop era"); the owner kept the fonts + shadow, and the warm rust/ember accent is the
one ownable colour we already have. Light/paper/contrast use rust, dark uses ember, midnight sky and graphite coral give those modes
their own personality. If the S15ag logo forces another accent, change MODES in contrast.py and rerun; never hand-edit tables.

| mode | personality | when |
|---|---|---|
| paper | warm lab notebook; current DEV look refined | owner's favourite ground; recommended for demo video + public pages |
| light | neutral SaaS white (Linear/Vercel light) | users who dislike warm grounds |
| dark | neutral near-black, orange ember accent | default dark |
| midnight | deep ink-blue, sky accent; "observatory" | night demo, video recording |
| graphite | warm charcoal, coral accent; low glare | long sessions |
| contrast | pure black/white, 2px borders, no tinted badges | accessibility, prefers-contrast |

Naming: tokens are `--r2s-<key>`. Map existing names: `--r2s-ink`=text, `--r2s-ok`=success, `--r2s-warn`=warning, `--r2s-accent-ink`=accent-contrast.
Keep `--r2s-border` for dividers only (decorative, exempt); every control/state border uses `--r2s-border-strong` (>=3:1, WCAG 1.4.11).

## Non-contrast tokens (same keys every mode)

| token | paper / light / contrast | dark / midnight / graphite |
|---|---|---|
| --r2s-overlay (modal/drawer scrim) | rgba(28,26,22,.42) | rgba(0,0,0,.62) |
| --r2s-shadow-1 (cards, tool rows) | 2px 2px 0 var(--r2s-shadow) | 2px 2px 0 var(--r2s-shadow) |
| --r2s-shadow-2 (primary button, active pane, question card) | 4px 4px 0 var(--r2s-shadow) | 3px 3px 0 var(--r2s-shadow) |
| --r2s-shadow-3 (popover, drawer, toast) | 6px 6px 0 var(--r2s-shadow), 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.12) | 4px 4px 0 var(--r2s-shadow), 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55) |
| --r2s-glow (focus ring) | 0 0 0 2px var(--r2s-surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--r2s-focus) | same |
| --r2s-hairline (inner top highlight on elevated) | none | inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06) |

Contrast mode: shadow-1/2 become `3px 3px 0 #000`, no blur in shadow-3, borders 2px, badges are white with 2px coloured border + fg text.

## Badge mapping (verbatim labels, never reworded)

| label | tokens |
|---|---|
| RECORDED, owner clip, MEASURED | recorded-bg / recorded-fg |
| SIMULATED, FIXTURE | simulated-bg / simulated-fg |
| what-if, scale unverified, Held-out caveat | whatif-bg / whatif-fg (+ warning icon) |

Chart: series 1 = text, series 2 = muted, highlight = accent (myfront: two shades + one accent).

## Token tables + computed WCAG ratios

Pairs checked: text/muted/accent/success/warning/danger on bg, surface, elevated (>=4.5); accent-contrast on accent, each badge fg on badge bg (>=4.5); border-strong, focus, shadow slab on bg/surface (>=3). Result of last run: 6 modes x 27 pairs, 0 failures.
